metadata.title: Earnings To Watch: Metacon AB (OSTO:META) Q2 2026 -- GF Value Sees 240% Upside

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Metacon AB (OSTO:META) is set to release its Q2 2026 earnings on Aug 12, 2026. The consensus estimate for Q2 2026 revenue is 89 million, and the earnings are expected to come in at -0.01 per share.
